Method of Attack: DLL hijacking by loading an arbitrary, unsigned DLL file within a trusted process
Privilege escalation to SYSTEM privileges by exploiting missing DLL loading checks
Persistence by executing malicious payload every time the vulnerable service loads
Discoverer: Trần Văn Khang of Infiniti Team - VinCSS
Impacted Systems: Windows systems running Trend Micro Password Manager
Trend Micro Password Manager Central Control Service (PwmSvc.exe)
Attack Vector: Exploitation of missing DLL file loading from uncontrolled paths including c:/python27 directory
Loading unsigned DLLs within trusted signed Trend Micro processes
Indicators of Compromise: Unsigned DLL loaded from c:\python27 directory
